A test post in R, marked as a draft.

```{r}
#| label: fig-test-r
#| fig-cap: "The same two quantities on a log scale: now the small one is visible."
#| fig-height: 2
library(ggplot2)
d <- data.frame(what = c("Big", "Small"), value = c(1000, 1))
ggplot(d, aes(value, what, fill = what)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Big = "#1F1D1A", Small = "#B23A26"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```
